brief.text: Real estate investment trusts feature heavily in the cluster activity with BXMT, FBRT, and SEVN all drawing multi-insider purchases, though UPBD stands out with an unusual concentration of seven separate buyers totaling $1,390,755. The single largest commitment by far was a $24,999,992 purchase of LYEL by Arch Venture Partners IX, eclipsing the next-largest individual transaction of $3,605,116 in ETRA. Among overall cluster totals, TTMI led all companies with $3,616,552 across three buyers, while BXMT’s total was heavily driven by CEO Timothy Steven Johnson’s $1,035,351 buy.
